Callout.Name: Seizure
Callout.Message: Person having a seizure in the street.
Callout.Advisory: Caller keeping people back, seizure ongoing.
Callout.Patient: What happened? Why is everybody looking at me?

Lines.Approach: It is still going on. The caller is keeping everybody back like they were told to.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
